chosen_titles.rationale: WV Chapter 6B (Public Officers and Employees) houses the Ethics Act; Article 3 within it is the lobbying-disclosure regime (registration, expenditure reports), with Articles 1-2 providing definitions and Ethics Commission enforcement scaffolding.

notes: WV 2010 vintage available directly. URL slug is `chapter06b/` (lowercase, no dash) — 2015 used `chapter-6b/`. The 2010 title-level anchor reads 'PUBLIC OFFICERS AND EMPLOYEES' (the chapter's umbrella name) rather than 'Ethics Act'; the Ethics Act lives inside it as Articles 1-3.
